InitialLoadingHint: Your library will be ready in a moment.
SearchPlaceholder: Search a photo, a scene, a memory…
Name: Name
EmptyLibrary: No media yet. Add a folder to get started.
SelectionOnly: Only this selection will be compressed.
InputPlaceholder: Choose the folder containing your media
KeepSmaller: Use smaller re-encodings only; otherwise copy the original
OriginalsSafe: Every media file is exported: re-encoded or copied unchanged. Sources are never deleted.
QualityHint: Very small quality loss with substantial space savings. Recommended by default.
BalancedDescription: Balance visual quality, size and encoding time.
MaximumHint: Prioritize space. Automatic mode may reduce resolution when the quality checks allow it.
VideoContainer: MKV when compatible with all tracks. The original is kept if a required track cannot be preserved.
EncodingFinished: Export complete: every planned file has been verified.
NoMedia: This folder contains no supported media.
ModelChanging: Changing model and rebuilding the library…
ActiveModelDelete: Select another installed model before deleting the active one.
NoFacesFound: No usable face found. Choose a clearer portrait.
ChooseTargetFaces: Select the same person in each reference photo. For group photos, choose the target face explicitly.
PersonExplanation: Choose a few photos of the same person. Faces are compared locally on your computer. Keywords give matching photos priority in search. Recognition can make mistakes.
ReferenceLimit: Choose at most 20 reference photos of the same person.
PerceptualLosslessHint: Almost no visible change. Each candidate is checked against the source.
AdvancedVisibilityHint: These choices remain active when this panel is collapsed. Auto selects a suitable codec for each file.
SelectedEncoderUnavailable: The selected encoder is unavailable for this media. Choose an available encoder or Auto.
AutoQualityHint: Auto uses a 0–100 perceptual quality target. Higher values prioritize fidelity.
NativeQualityHint: This value belongs to the selected encoder. Changing encoder does not convert quality scales.
PngQualityHint: PNG is always pixel lossless. This control changes compression effort, not visual quality.
AutomaticContainer: The file extension follows the codec selected for each image.
KeepOriginalHint: Copy the original into the output, retaining all tracks and metadata.
MetadataAlwaysPreserved: Metadata preservation is required for a complete export. If it cannot be verified after encoding, the original is copied.
ExportIncomplete: Export incomplete: keep the source folder.
